title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on .moeb/README.md
description: patch_file failed 3 times on .moeb/README.md with 'removed lines not in file' and 'removed lines not matching' errors despite read_file_range and grep_files confirming byte-identical content. Recovery required full file reconstruction via write_file. This is now the 2nd occurrence of this failure pattern across spec runs.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file removed-line matching fails on .moeb/README.md even when read_file_range reports identical content. Likely a hidden character or encoding artifact not caught by normalize_line_endings or normalize_trailing_whitespace. Add byte-level diagnostic logging at the mismatch point.
